question: Which gene is most frequently associated with acquired mutations in breast cancer?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Breast cancer" -> "acquired mutations" -> "p53 gene frequently mutated" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Breast cancer" -> "acquired mutations" -> "BRCA-1 gene associated" -> "less frequent than p53" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Breast cancer" -> "acquired mutations" -> "PTEN gene mutations" -> "less common than p53" -> 60%
CHAIN: "Breast cancer" -> "acquired mutations" -> "BRCA-2 gene mutations" -> "less common than p53" -> 65%
CHAIN: "Breast cancer" -> "acquired mutations" -> "Her2/neu mutations" -> "not primarily associated" -> 50%
analysis: The p53 gene is the most frequently associated with acquired mutations in breast cancer. While BRCA-1 and BRCA-2 are linked to hereditary breast cancer, p53 mutations are commonly found in sporadic cases of breast cancer, making it a significant player in acquired mutations.
